objective: Build the Petal Catch Blender props to the garden-wheel.md section 6 contract: wheel_stand, wheel_disc with 8 painted wedges in the egg colours, wheel_basket, petal_pink, petal_gold, pinecone and the optional wheel_tree, in the manifest, the generated GardenAssets module, the register and the Blender plan.
acceptance_criteria: manifest.json has entries for wheel_stand (7 x 8 x 2, pointer at the top centre), wheel_disc (6 across, 0.6 thick, one mesh, bounding box centre on the axle, 8 wedges painted in the EGG_COLOURS pairs in the disc order meadow, forest, sunset, coins, moon, star, celestial, aurora clockwise from the pointer, coins in gold), wheel_basket (1.6 across), petal_pink and petal_gold (1.2 across, under 100 tris, gold baked bright), pinecone (1.0 tall, under 200 tris, round scales, no spikes) and, if time allows, wheel_tree (24 canopy, 20 tall, trunk at the x, z centre)
Every model is one mesh in the toy style, 100 to 3,000 tris, fronts on Blender -Y; GardenAssets.spec.luau pins size and parts to the manifest

src/shared/GardenAssets.luau is regenerated by tools/blender/write-assets-module.mjs garden with nil ids until the Director's upload step runs; docs/assets/register.md has one row per model (studio-owned original work) before any id is used; docs/assets/garden-blender-plan.md lists the props with sizes and a lineup preview
No file outside files changes; lune run tests/run GardenAssets passes; the contact sheet shows the disc's 8 colours readable at 6 studs
verification: CI (GardenAssets.spec), A15 looks at the lineup and the disc against EGG_COLOURS and the GDD names
notes: Code never waits for art: WheelWorld and WheelFx keep part fallbacks until an id is uploaded. Pivots are not kept on import (architecture 9), so the disc must be symmetric about its axle and the stand's pointer sits at the top centre of its bounding box. The disc's wedge texture is the only place the odds order is drawn; it must match GardenConfig.WHEEL.wedges order or the pointer lands on the wrong colour. Cut order: wheel_tree first (Props.sakura stays), then the basket.
